thought.text: The "Loading..." text shows! Now check if your Android loads assets:

reasoning_content:
The browser is now showing "Arelorian Loading..." - which means it DOES load! The "black screen" was actually the game trying to run but with no visual feedback.

The question is - is the game actually running behind the black canvas, or is it failing silently? Let me check the nginx logs to see if mobile is actually loading assets:

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check latest access log for Android
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -30 /var/log/nginx/access.log | grep -i 'android\\|chrome.*mobile'")
print("Mobile access:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
